title: Smart Data Models - DigitalPerformanceAsset schema
description: An advertising account of a Brand on a paid-media platform (e.g. Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads). It is the stable entity to which campaign-level performance observations (DigitalPerformanceAssetMetric) are attached. There is one DigitalPerformanceAsset per Brand and platform.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DigitalPerformanceAsset

digitalAssetKind.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. High-level kind of the asset. Same enumeration as DigitalAsset.digitalAssetKind in this subject. Advertising accounts use PaidAds. Enum:'Web, MobileApp, SocialProfile, SearchEngine, PaidAds, VideoPlatform, Email, Newsletter, Podcast, Marketplace, Other'

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refBrand.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. Identifier of the Brand that owns this advertising account

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refSoftwareApplication.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. Identifier of the SoftwareApplication (advertising platform) where the account lives, e.g. urn:ngsi-ld:SoftwareApplication:GoogleAds
